title: Plain Words, Either Dialect
html:
Plain Words, Either Dialect

Plain words➜Walk once, with Claude➜Kept script➜Replay, 0 tokens, either dialect

HAL-FORMS carries the release. HAL Schema Forms carries it with what a replay with no model leans on: pinned forms, real types, full checks. The reference dialect, and the on-ramp.
say: So: eight lines of plain words, walked once with Claude, and replayed with no model in either of HEART's dialects. HAL-FORMS carries the release; HAL Schema Forms carries it with the safety layer a replay with no model leans on. That's why HAL Schema Forms stays the reference dialect, and HAL-FORMS the on-ramp.
